regime_context: Hong Kong thematic detector shows a narrowing eligible universe (5 of 17 themes pass the absolute trend gate). Tech Hardware & Semis is the leading eligible theme but has low breadth (0.17); Conglomerates & Exchange shows high durability (0.68) and full participation (breadth 1.0). No eligible theme has a scorable proxy, so all would-be calls are unscorable and conviction must be low. The validated edge is purely drawdown control from the trend gate, not return forecasting.
emerging_watch: Watch Tech Hardware & Semis for potential leadership consolidation: if its breadth (currently 0.17) rises above 0.5 within 10 trading days, it could signal a more robust and investable trend. Kill criterion: no breadth improvement after 10 days, implying the theme remains a low-breadth, fragile leader not suitable for an overweight lean.

theses.thesis: Conglomerates & Exchange is the only eligible theme with strong breadth (1.0) and high trend durability (0.68), suggesting a cohesive, non-crowded uptrend that may persist over the medium term if the broad-based participation holds. The overweight lean is conditional on the absolute trend gate remaining intact and breadth staying high, reflecting a bet on the trend’s staying power rather than any momentum forecast. The detector’s rank-IC ~0 and lack of scorable proxy demand low conviction.
